name: projects
title: Projects
description: Keeps a page for every project you're working on, from a trip you're planning to something you're building: its goal, what you might need, and a task list. Your tasks go on your Google Tasks list with a date, and Jori follows up when one slips. Tasks Jori can do itself (code, documents, research) it does overnight and brings to you for review. Kept current every night from your memory, calendar and tasks, and corrected by the dream.

task.description: Nightly: keep a wiki page and a task list for each project the user is working on (goal, what they might need, tasks, coming up, lately) from memory, calendar and tasks; follow up on slipped tasks; pick the work Jori can do.
